method_notes: Breadth-first census built entirely from pages fetched during this task: four Wikipedia stadium lists (England, Scotland, Wales-by-capacity, Northern Ireland) plus the 2026-27 Cymru Premier and NIFL Premiership club/ground tables were downloaded as rendered HTML and parsed mechanically (rowspans resolved, capacity templates expanded), so every name, capacity and city here was read from a real table cell rather than recalled. Coordinates, street addresses and official-website URLs came from the Wikidata API keyed on those articles' enwiki titles; 407 resulting official club/venue homepages were then fetched (357 returned 200) and every calendar URL recorded below was extracted from that fetched HTML, never guessed, then itself fetched (355 of 360 returned 200). Manchester City refused the bulk probe with HTTP 403 and was re-fetched by hand, so the Etihad Stadium entry is evidenced the same way as the rest. Coverage: all four nations, the top four English tiers plus National League/North/South grounds above ~5,000, every Scottish ground at or above 1,000, all NIFL Premiership and Cymru Premier grounds, and the national stadiums. Limitations to read honestly: capacity is almost entirely GRADE_C (Wikipedia tables, sometimes corroborated by Wikidata P1083) because the official club and stadium pages checked - Wembley, Hampden, Windsor Park, Old Trafford, Spurs, Etihad, Emirates, Ibrox, Wrexham - publish no capacity figure in fetchable HTML; only Swansea.com Stadium yielded a GRADE_A official figure. Where two fetched sources disagree (notably NIFL's current licensed capacities vs the NI stadium list) the current-season club table was preferred and the conflict is recorded with capacity_confidence LOW. events_currently_present is a mechanical signal (schema.org Event blocks or date-like strings in the fetched HTML), left null where a page returned 200 but was client-rendered. Murrayfield Stadium and Kingston Park appear in football-stadium source lists but were excluded because every tenant evidenced is a rugby organisation; Principality Stadium is included because the brief names it, flagged in its evidence as having no football use evidenced. Non-football venues in the Welsh general stadium list (rugby, cricket, ice hockey) were excluded. Only "Current stadiums" sections were used, so no closed or under-construction grounds are listed.
